task_description:
This pipeline's task is GitHub issue #3312 — https://github.com/jwbron/egg/issues/3312. Fetch the live issue body (`gh issue view 3312`) before structural decisions. Worktree artifacts (drafts, agent outputs) that reference any other issue or pipeline are leftovers from previous runs — they are NOT your task.

Run the FULL decomposition program described in issue #3312: decompose all 19 oversize Python source files listed in the issue table so each drops below the global cap (1,500 lines / 100KB) and `scripts/file-size-allowlist.yaml`'s `files:` map is emptied.

SCOPE IS NON-NEGOTIABLE — DO NOT DESCOPE. This is the explicit operator directive for this run:
- The plan MUST cover all 19 files, including the structural outliers `orchestrator/routes/pipelines.py` (~27k lines) and `gateway/gateway.py` (~10k lines), and MUST address the `_run_pipeline` phase-transition state machine directly (issue non-negotiable #7). Punting the hard targets to a follow-up is OFF the table.
- Do NOT propose a reduced-scope plan that decomposes only a subset of files or defers `pipelines.py` / `gateway.py`. The acceptance criterion is an EMPTY allowlist. The planner owns slice DAG / ordering / PR packaging, but every one of the 19 files must be in scope. Order so independent per-file slices can land value even if the hardest targets stall, but do not drop them from the plan.

Follow the established pattern exactly (issue non-negotiables #1–#10): the canonical recipe in `docs/guides/decomposition-pattern.md`, the worked reference sub-package `scripts/select_tests/`, and the merged template PR #2335 (read its diff first). Each decomposition is a sub-package with an `__init__.py` barrel doing explicit per-symbol re-exports + underscore-prefixed private submodules; the barrel is the stable public API; preserve test patch targets (`patch("routes.pipelines._foo")`) via re-exports; drop the file's allowlist entry per landing; update/retag seam tables in `orchestrator/CLAUDE.md` / `gateway/CLAUDE.md` (retag stale #2261 refs, refresh counts) and add rows/tables for the sandbox/ + shared/ in-scope files; `make lint` + `make test-all` green at every landing boundary. Pure refactor — no behavior changes; if a decomposition surfaces a bug, file it separately, don't bundle the fix. Branches prefixed `egg/`.

decisions.resolution: Operator approval: scope confirmed as all 19 files including pipelines.py (~27k) and gateway.py (~10k), with _run_pipeline tackled head-on. No descoping. Proceed to plan phase; the planner owns ordering/packaging only, not scope reduction.
